content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITI Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit hard copy of application by speed post or in person. Submit to the Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute Balodabazar (Sakari), Pin Code - 493228. Attach self-attested copies of required documents and affidavit. Make sure it reaches by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Balodabazar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ITI Balodabazar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 English Language, 1 Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (Hindi).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ITI Balodabazar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 5 of PDF) and send it to Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute Balodabazar (Sakari), District-Balodabazar Bhatapara (Chhattisgarh) Pin Code-493228, by speed post or in person, to reach by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 140 per hour (max Rs. 15000/month) for English Language, Rs. 140 per hour (max Rs. 15000/month) for Stenographer Secretarial Assistant (Hindi).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in English with B.Ed. or 12th pass with shorthand and typing qualifications. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh. Separate application must be submitted for each trade. All documents must be self-attested.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants without Chhattisgarh domicile. Applicants whose application is incomplete, unclear or has errors. Applicants without a signed application and affidavit. Applicants whose photo and certificates are not self-attested.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared based on technical qualification marks. Skill test for stenographer posts. Merit based on technical qualification marks. Shorthand skill test for stenographer posts.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Invited for session 2026-27 or until regular/transferred/deputation/contract staff joins.
